header: One location, with the address as an address element
text:
The text field keeps the line breaks an editor typed
so the postal address stays copyable
rather than becoming one run-on line
caption: The caption belongs to the picture, not to the address.
note: The map is a still image the editor uploaded and the directions link goes out to whichever service they use, so nothing is fetched from a map provider when the page loads.
